title: MG20_RecipeCore
description: "An easy-to-use recipe viewer! Hold any item in your hand and type /recipe to instantly see how to craft it."
body:
# MG20_RecipeCore

A simple, lightweight plugin that allows players to view crafting recipes directly in-game.

### How to use:
1. Hold the item you want to check in your hand.
2. Type `/recipe`.
3. The recipe will be displayed instantly!

### Features:
- **Lightweight & Efficient:** Built to run smoothly without impacting server performance.
- **Simple:** No complex GUIs or commands to learn.
- **Player Friendly:** Perfect for survival servers where players often need help with crafting recipes.

This plugin is designed to improve the player experience on your server by providing instant access to recipe information without needing to leave the game or look up external wikis.
